title: Bathroom Routine Deviation Alert
dataSources: Daily activity (`eldercare:activity`), fall alerts (`fall:alert`), medication reminders (`medreminder:event`), check-in calls (`checkin:call`), wandering alerts (`wandering:alert`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — activity and fall sensors (Apple Watch fall detection, motion mats), medication dispensers, and check-in / video-call logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and smart-home hubs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=eldercare:activity activity_type=bathroom_visit
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as visits by _time resident
| eventstats avg(visits) as baseline by resident
| where abs(visits-baseline)>2
| sort - visits
description: Flags days where bathroom-visit frequency deviates sharply from a resident's baseline pattern.
value: Routine deviations can be one of the first observable signs that something physical or cognitive has changed.
implementation: Tag bathroom visits in `eldercare:activity`; compare daily counts with each resident's average baseline.
visualization: Table of outlier days with bathroom-visit deviation.
grandmaExplanation: It spots when a daily bathroom routine suddenly looks very different from normal.
